title: Styling
description:
We need to always be sure that changes make the styles better. In the last changes, text and gradients were added to places that did not make sense. ALWAYS be sure that text is legible against it's background, this means dark text on light backgrounds and vice-versa. The homepage hero is currently unreadable. In addition, changes to icon backgrounds created inconsistencies. The key to each section must be consistency in the details.

Key issues to fix:
- Hero section text legibility (white on white problem)
- Gradient applications that reduce readability
- Icon background consistency across sections
- Ensure proper contrast ratios throughout
